name: Balanced Dollar
oneLiner: bnUSD is Balanced's cross-chain decentralized dollar backed by crypto loan collateral and USDC or USDT held in its Stability Fund.
collateral: SODAX cross-chain money-market borrower collateral backing all facilitator-minted bnUSD; measured 2026-07-30 at Sonic block 76778944: ~39.8% sodahyTB (HiYield Treasury Bill Vault), ~23.7% sodaUSDC, ~7.2% sodaBTC, ~6.9% sodaBNB, ~3.7% each sodaAVAX and sodaSUI, ~3.4% sodasftUSD, ~2.3% sodaETH, ~2.0% sodaUSDT, and a long tail of other SODAX-wrapped crypto collateral. Stability Fund approved-stablecoin 1:1 swaps mint through the same facilitator, so those stablecoin deposits are part of the measured borrower-collateral base
pegMechanism: Users borrow bnUSD against eligible crypto collateral through Balanced's cross-chain money market, while the Stability Fund mints or burns bnUSD 1:1 against USDC and USDT to support the peg

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Balanced describes bnUSD as a crypto-backed stablecoin minted through collateralized positions and its Stability Fund. This is a collateralized-debt-position stabilization path, so the CDP archetype is the supported classification; the current collateral allocation remains separately bounded by the reserve review.

notices.title: Primary issuance lives on ICON, not yet a Pharos-supported chain
notices.message: bnUSD is minted on ICON (canonical contract cx88fd7df7ddff82f7cc735c871dc519838cb235bb) where ~95% of supply currently sits. Balanced uses its xCall infrastructure to extend the same supply to other chains, so the EVM/Injective contracts tracked here represent cross-chain burn-mint representations of the ICON-issued supply. Additional active deployments on Archway and Havah (also not Pharos-supported) are visible in DefiLlama but excluded from contracts[] until those chains are wired into Pharos; the Optimism deployment was verified and added 2026-07-20.

notices.title: Balanced v1 transition and v2 launch
notices.message: Balanced's current documentation says v2 launched on April 7, 2026 and the original v1 app is no longer supported. The deployments tracked here are the historical v1 ICON-Hub bnUSD entry; current v2 issuance, reserves, and authority are not asserted until a verified active contract inventory is available.
